text.text: Rules of thumb
Two sources for any serious claim.
Call the person criticized before publishing.
If in doubt, hold the story one day.
A visible, quick correction is a sign of a trustworthy newsroom. Hiding a mistake is what hurts.
When someone reports an error
Log it on the Corrections table the moment it arrives.
The editor checks the claim against notes and documents.
If it is wrong, fix the story and add a correction note at the top or bottom.
Press Mark fixed and thank the reader who reported it.
Never
Quietly change text with no note on a material error.
Argue with the reader before checking.
Leave an error up while you decide.
Most local news starts in a meeting room. A good plan turns a long night into one clear story.
Before
Download the agenda and packet
List the items likely to matter and who will speak
Check the livestream or recording options
During
Note the time of each vote and how each member voted.
Get names and spellings from the sign-in sheet.
Ask one clarifying question in the break.
After
Call anyone whose statement needs checking
File within the budget deadline
Press Mark covered on the event
